body.cap: Moqous' smart mobility product 'Vulcan' | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Moqous Co., Ltd. (CEO Hong Bokyong) participated in CES 2025, held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10 (local time), as part of the KOTRA Pavilion.

Founded in 2019, Moqous has rapidly established itself as a leading company in the smart mobility sector. The company aims to offer solutions that promote creativity, freedom, and collaboration, providing customers with a new and differentiated lifestyle experience.

As a fabless company specializing in design, development, and engineering, Moqous has gained recognition for its electric two-wheelers and boards. The company aims to continue its growth by introducing new ideas and positioning itself as a global leader in the smart mobility market.

At CES 2025, Moqous introduced its new electric bike, Vulcan, which drew significant attention from visitors. Vulcan features a frame made of AL7075 aluminum alloy (duralumin), offering exceptional strength while maintaining a lightweight structure.

The bike incorporates a patented sliding mechanism and a three-stage folding design, significantly enhancing portability. According to the company, Vulcan also allows over 97 levels of length adjustment, providing a customizable riding experience tailored to users of various body types.

body.cap: CEO Hong Bokyong and Alex Sigrist, AVING News reporter, during an interview | Photo by AVING News
Alex Sigrist and Moqous CEO Hong Bokyong with team members in a commemorative photo | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A Moqous representative stated, "We are thrilled to unveil our innovative electric bike at CES 2025 and showcase it to potential global customers for the first time. This opportunity allows us to introduce our brand worldwide, gather consumer feedback, and accelerate our goal of becoming a leader in global smart mobility trends."

The representative added, "Moqous will continue developing diverse mobility products and expanding into shared mobility stations and F&B robots. With these innovations, we aim to bridge the gap between online and offline, creating a seamless connection for all mobility solutions and establishing ourselves as leaders of 'Mobility + UniQuarters.'"
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
